name: What are common pitfalls to avoid during an accessible bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What are common pitfalls to avoid during an accessible bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common pitfalls include underestimating the required space for maneuverability, neglecting future needs, choosing non-compliant materials, or overlooking proper waterproofing. For example, not accounting for turning radii for wheelchairs can render a seemingly accessible design ineffective. Ensuring thorough planning, selecting experienced professionals like Hometelligent Inc., and adhering to accessibility standards will help avoid these issues and result in a truly functional space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid pitfalls like underestimating space, neglecting future needs, using non-compliant materials, or poor waterproofing. Thorough planning and experienced professionals prevent these issues.
